subs.heroText: The live meter and almost every tab are free for everyone. With a Discord account at least 8 months old your first 30 days include everything; after that only Party, rotations and Gear Viewer need a Patreon plan.
subs.source.grantForever: Given by the developer, no expiry
subs.source.free: Party, rotations and Gear Viewer are locked. Everything else is free.
subs.source.signedOut: Sign in with Discord to start your 30-day free trial (Discord account at least 8 months old).
subs.offlineHint: Server unreachable: showing your last verified plan.
subs.unlinkConfirm: Unlink Patreon from this account? The paid tabs lock until you link it again.
subs.paid.all: Everything unlocked: Party, rotations and Gear Viewer
subs.plansNote: Every plan unlocks the same features: only how often you pay changes, and the longer the period, the more you save.
subs.free.meter: Live DPS, HPS and aggro meter
subs.free.rest: Every other tab: fight reports, online logs, rankings, database, characters, map and organizer
subs.lockedText: This tab unlocks with any Patreon plan. Subscribe on Patreon, then link it to your account.
subs.lockedSignedOut: Every tab unlocks for 30 days after your first sign-in, with a Discord account at least 8 months old. No payment needed.
subs.lockedTrial: Sign in with Discord and try everything free for 30 days
subs.waiver: I request immediate access to the digital content and understand that I thereby lose my 14-day right of withdrawal.
subs.deviceLimit: Your plan is already active on another PC (at most {n}; Empyrean 2). A PC frees its place after 30 days without using it, or you can ask for a reset on the PowerMeter Discord.
subs.lockedSoonText: Party, rotations and Gear Viewer are reserved to the Patreon plans, coming soon.
